photos.title: Wood & wire garden fence
photos.caption: Warm-toned wood rails frame wire panels beside a green lawn and gravel border.

photos.title: Mosaic niches taking shape
photos.caption: Marble-look wall tiles surround two stacked mosaic niches. The tub edge and tools show this is still a work site.

photos.title: Wood-look flooring through the room
photos.caption: Warm wood-look planks run through the room toward a bright doorway, with white trim at the edges.

photos.title: Garden steps revealed
photos.caption: A defined flight of garden steps leads toward the gate, with the surrounding soil still exposed.

photos.title: Exterior with a blue entry
photos.caption: Light-colored siding and trim frame a vivid blue front door beneath the tall roofline.

photos.title: Side yard after clearing
photos.caption: The side passage is open again, revealing three raised planting beds along the chain-link fence.

photos.title: Privacy fence from the inside
photos.caption: Vertical wood boards are supported by horizontal rails and dark posts along a narrow planted boundary.

photos.title: Shower wall preparation
photos.caption: Red-coated wall boards and two recessed niches are visible before the tile goes on; the tub below is protected.

photos.title: Tile installation underway
photos.caption: Marble-look tiles and a mosaic niche are being fitted, with tile spacers and red-coated wall areas still visible.

photos.title: Tub surround and mosaic band
photos.caption: A horizontal mosaic accent runs into the stacked niches above the tub. Masking tape remains along the ceiling edge.

photos.title: The original shower niche
photos.caption: Before the remodel: a mosaic-backed niche set into the original white tile wall.

photos.title: The shower before the remodel
photos.caption: Before the remodel: the original white tile enclosure with a curtain rail, corner baskets and a recessed niche.

photos.title: Flooring at the doorway
photos.caption: Wood-look flooring meets white baseboards and a doorway, with blue masking tape still visible on the trim.

photos.title: Cool gray room palette
photos.caption: Gray walls, white baseboards and gray-brown plank flooring meet beneath a small window; supplies remain on the floor.

photos.title: Room viewed from the hall
photos.caption: A doorway view shows the gray room, contrasting white trim and plank floor while cleanup is still underway.

photos.title: Open wall and insulation
photos.caption: Exposed wall studs and insulation show an interior room during the wall-preparation stage.

photos.title: Drywall seams in progress
photos.caption: Drywall panels have taped and coated seams, while tools and materials remain on the unfinished floor.

photos.title: A bold blue front door
photos.caption: A paneled entry door has a bright blue finish, with masking tape and painting supplies still around the threshold.

photos.title: Siding before finishing
photos.caption: A replaced section of siding is still unfinished on this wall.

photos.title: The painted wall
photos.caption: The same wall after painting: siding and trim in one even light color, with the paint can still at ground level.

photos.title: Fence following the lawn
photos.caption: Wood-and-wire fence panels follow the edge of a sloping lawn, with a gravel strip along the base.

photos.title: Added privacy above the fence
photos.caption: A row of taller warm-toned boards rises above an older weathered fence section.

photos.title: Fence framework underway
photos.caption: Dark posts and horizontal wood rails mark out a fence line beside the street before the infill is installed.

photos.title: The fence standing again
photos.caption: The wood privacy fence stands straight along the side passage on its new posts.

photos.title: Replacing a rotted post
photos.caption: A steel replacement post beside the old weathered rail, where the rotted wood post came out.

photos.title: Side yard before clearing
photos.caption: Tall grass and dense weeds fill the narrow passage between the house and the chain-link fence.

photos.title: Cleared garden area
photos.caption: An open garden area surrounds raised beds beneath a mature tree, with scattered clippings still on the ground.

photos.title: Garden steps during excavation
photos.caption: Grass and soil cover parts of the existing steps, while a dug-out lower section and shovel show work underway.

photos.title: Paved garden landing
photos.caption: Rectangular pavers form a small landing and path beside a planted border.

photos.title: Leaf-covered sidewalk edge
photos.caption: Fallen leaves and brush blanket the strip between a wooded slope and the sidewalk.

photos.title: Cleared sidewalk border
photos.caption: The ground beside a wooded sidewalk has been cleared back, exposing soil around the tree trunks.

photos.title: Parking lot before restriping
photos.caption: Worn, cracked asphalt with no visible parking bays. Cones are set out and the lot is being cleared.

photos.title: Fresh parking bay markings
photos.caption: Bright white parking-space lines cross the asphalt, with cones still standing in the lot.

photos.title: Asphalt patch detail
photos.caption: A rectangular dark asphalt patch contrasts with the older pavement around it.

photos.title: Landscape block course
photos.caption: Textured landscape blocks form a low course against exposed soil, with the hollow block tops still visible.

pairs.title: Opening up a side yard
pairs.note: Before and after: the deck, satellite dish, neighboring wall and fence align in both views.

pairs.title: Finding the steps again
pairs.note: Progress and after: the gate, silver-leaved planting and stair position match. The first photo already shows excavation underway.

pairs.title: From the original shower to new tile
pairs.note: The first two photos show the original shower before this project. The rest are progress photos of the rebuild, not a completed shower.

pairs.title: Clearing a leaf-covered walkway
pairs.note: Before and after: the leaf- and brush-covered strip beside the sidewalk, cleared back to bare soil.

pairs.title: Restriping a parking lot
pairs.note: Before and after: worn asphalt with no visible bays, then fresh white parking lines.

pairs.title: Siding repair
pairs.note: Before and after: a replaced section of siding, then the finished wall.

pairs.title: Replacing rotted fence posts
pairs.note: Before and after: a steel replacement post going in where the wood post had rotted, and the fence standing again.
